description: List a private app's service tokens: the bearer credentials scripts and other apps call it with. Each token shows its name, whether it is live, expired, or retiring (the old value of a rotation, which keeps working until the time shown), its expiry, who minted it and when, and the callers' env vars a rotation delivered it to. A token's value is never shown. Call it before rotate_app_token to find a token's name and the callers it will update. Requires connecting a Valet account. Requires the Admin role.

name.description: The app's name, as list_services shows it: the app whose tokens these are.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_app_tokens

app.description: The app the tokens belong to.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

tokens.description: The app's tokens, oldest first. Empty when it has none.

created_at.description: When this value was minted or rotated in, RFC 3339.

created_by.description: The email of the member who minted or rotated it. Empty for a person who no longer exists.

deliveries.description: The callers' env vars a rotation wrote this value into. Empty when none.

env_var.description: The secret env var on the caller that holds the value.

expires_at.description: When the token expires, RFC 3339. Absent for one that never expires.

retiring_until.description: When a retiring value stops working, RFC 3339. Absent on a live or expired value.

status.description: live, expired, or retiring: the old value of a rotation, which works until retiring_until.

title: List an app's service tokens
